title: Brian J NDE 4952
content: My story started when I was having dinner at home. I live by myself with my two cats, and one evening, when I was having dinner all alone, I suddenly started to feel very light-headed, dizzy and short of breath. I decided to try to make it to my bedroom so I could lie down, with the hope it would subside. I never made it to the bedroom. I was suffering from a heart problem I did not know I had. There was a dresser with no drawers in it in the spare bedroom, and I could see myself lying inside this dresser all curled up in a ball. I watched as one of my cats (Compass) walked up to me and lay down by my side. Suddenly, I saw this very bright and pulsating light. It was like a strobe light, but a hundred times faster. It was pulsating so fast that it was almost a steady light. I heard people calling my name. Next, I found myself traveling to a place that was beyond comprehension. I was no longer feeling the pain that I had been when all of this started. It was a very strange feeling, unlike any I had ever felt before. I knew that somebody or something was guiding me through this very strange, but very loving, journey. This person or thing loved me very much, even though I could not tell who or what it was. Then, in a split second, there were people surrounding me - people whom I had never seen before. I could feel love from these people, like no love that I had ever felt before. I did not want to leave this place. In this place, I was pain-free and surrounded by strange people who loved me very much. I was hearing this lady's voice saying over and over, 'Brian, get up, you have to get up Brian, Brian get up,' when suddenly I awoke, gasping for air and lying inside this empty dresser in a big pool of sweat. I was aware of having scrapes and gouges from the dresser and of my cat Compass lying next to me, just like I had watched him do. When I awoke, there was no lady there - like I said, I live alone. The next day I went to see my doctor, who confirmed my heart problem. I just know that I 'cannot' wait to go back there, even though I know that I can't go there again for a long, long time.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported seeing himself lying curled up in a ball inside an empty dresser in the spare bedroom.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: He described 'traveling to a place that was beyond comprehension' but did not describe a tunnel/void.

arrival.other_being_detail: He sensed an unidentified guiding 'somebody or something' and later was surrounded by 'people' he had never seen before who radiated love.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He heard a woman's voice repeating 'Brian, get up...' immediately before waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (seeing himself in dresser) → bright pulsating light → travel to incomprehensible place with guidance → surrounded by unknown people radiating love → heard woman's voice telling him to get up → woke back in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported being found/waking physically inside an empty dresser, and during the OBE he saw his cat Compass come lie next to his body; he also described an extremely fast pulsating/strobe-like bright light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “traveling to a place that was beyond comprehension.”; “I knew that somebody or something was guiding me through this very strange, but very loving, journey.”; “Brian, get up, you have to get up Brian, Brian get up.”; “I 'cannot' wait to go back there.”
